rv.q: The production value far outshines the script, but horror fans wanting to see dazzling and creepy effects will enjoy getting their fill.
The not-so-obvious trickery of American spiritualism is revived with gusto in “Paranormal Activity,” a sensational start to the spooky season.
Fisher's illusions are a must see and second to none: elegant, subtle, and exacting.
This is a compact, impressively told and wonderfully acted ghost story.
It scared the bejeebies out of me... and that didn't end at the curtain!
Guaranteed to deliver the horror movie-style scares you're looking for, but if you're looking for thematic depth, you're searching the wrong haunted house.
All in all, this scaredy cat of a reviewer had a fun time out at Paranormal Activity.

cn.t: Critics praise this stage adaptation for delivering effective jump scares and horror thrills just in time for spooky season, successfully translating the film franchise's terror to live theater.
